executive_assessment.text: NDC reports floods, droughts and cyclones have doubled in frequency since the 1980s.
Agriculture is largely rain-fed; under 1% of land is irrigated and most farmers cultivate under one hectare.
The NDC sets a 2030 target for agro-meteorological and early-warning services to reach 90 percent of farmers and fishers.
